m.t: Nečekal jsem, že to bude velký starý pytel kostí.

m.e: Then somebody took his wallet, keys, phone, and bones.

m.e: A ghost does not have flesh and bones, and you see I have both.

m.e: That rain will melt the flesh off your bones in under a minute.

m.e: All you had to do was break a few bones. It was a small matter.

m.e: The rest of these bones, I could put together with my eyes closed.
